detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 video

Cmd+Shift+V opens my clipboard history as a list of cards. I type a word and the link, the snippet or the address I copied an hour ago comes back. Cmd+Option+Z rewinds the clipboard to the previous clip.

It reads text inside screenshots on the machine, and quick actions strip tracking off links or format JSON. macOS 13 or later, no account, nothing uploaded.

Try ClipBuddy

#macos #productivity
